name: Inspect & Repair Primed Wall
intent: After primer cures, inspect for defects revealed by the primer (telegraphing seams, fastener pops, mud blemishes), spackle them, sand the spackle flush, spot-prime the repairs, and dust-wipe the wall before finish coats. QT2 skips this module entirely; QT3-5 all run it with rates that scale by tier scrutiny.
doctrine: Inspection happens after primer cures because primer reveals defects that are invisible on bare drywall. Skipping this module on QT3+ produces visible defects that telegraph through finish coats and cannot be corrected without rework. Inspection and spackle rates slow significantly at QT5 because the inspector is hunting for finer defects under stronger lighting. Spot prime and dust wipe are flat-rate because they're mechanical, not inspection-driven.
